fields.notes: Base CSI-2 is an on-board sensor->host link without built-in encryption; data confidentiality/integrity for the camera path are provided by higher layers or platform measures. ECC + CRC provide transmission error detection, not security.
fields.ic_name: MIPI CSI-2 (Camera Serial Interface 2, MIPI Alliance)
